title: Human Variant Evidence Review
description: Resolve one simple human variant and organize ClinVar, Ensembl VEP, and gnomAD evidence through a researcher-approved workflow.

tools.name: variant_evidence_preflight
tools.description: Resolve one exact RefSeq HGVS expression, rsID, ClinVar Variation ID, or VCV accession. Return the normalized allele, transcript, assembly, and ClinVar aggregate assertion for review before execution.

variant.description: Exact human variant identifier, preferably a versioned RefSeq coding HGVS expression such as NM_000518.5:c.20A>T.

tools.name: variant_evidence_review
tools.description: Retrieve and persist an approved single-variant evidence review from ClinVar, Ensembl VEP, and gnomAD v4 without creating a custom pathogenicity score.
